patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) From the game install folder, navigate into the 'FightAngel_Data' folder, and then into the 'StreamingAssets' folder Download the patch archive from the link below Extract the 'abdata.dat' file from the downloaded patch archive into the 'StreamingAssets' folder mentioned above
